content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Result: deviation (MFN), preferred position taken.**

- No pricing MFN exists in the fee architecture (Articles V–VIII are a tiered per-trade table; the Revisions clause at p0094 runs in our favour and was not flagged).
- The responsive burden is Article XXII (p0139–p0141): we must notify Licensor of any bona fide third-party offer to buy our assets or merge, and Licensor gets five business days to take that offer — a most-favoured-offer/right-to-match mechanic on the Customer, which the playbook routes to MFN.
- It fails all three fallback elements (no defined product, whole term rather than 12 months, no like-for-like carve-out), so the redline removes the Customer-side obligation and conforms the two follow-on sentences so that "Right of First Refusal" and "Exercise Period" are not left dangling.
